driver_flags: -O3 -DNDEBUG -std=gnu++20; identical object linked into both executables
baseline_counter: Preserved original computation; appended cache.size() to CacheStatistics return so cached_reductions reports one reduction per grade. No other baseline-kernel edits.
order: Baseline first on odd repetitions, active first on even repetitions. Each workload and variant runs in a separate process. Within a workload: rank_blocks, streaming, filtered_ranks.
process_command: taskset -c 0 /usr/bin/time -f "%M %e %U %S" -o RESOURCE_FILE EXECUTABLE WORKLOAD ANSWER_DUMP FIXTURE
verification: All complete answer dumps compared byte-for-byte against the preserved baseline. Rank-block and streaming vectors compared exactly. Every timed warm answer compared with its cold answer.
caveats: Observed wall times on a shared laptop; no confidence intervals.
Peak RSS is for the entire workload process, including all three query methods and their allocator history.
Constructor timings can reflect preceding query methods in the same workload; no constructor-speed claim.
Only one small external file fixture, not a representative real-data study.
